name: Notebook
description: Write and keep longer thoughts, in folders, with every day they changed.
title: Notebook
emptyDescription: Start a document for anything worth more than a bullet point. Put documents inside other documents to group them.
bodyPlaceholder: Write freely. Markdown works, and @ mentions a person.
tooLong: This document is {{over}} bytes over the limit. Nothing is being saved until it is shorter.
historyEmpty: This document has not been written in yet.
diffNoChange: Nothing changed between these two days.
moveDescription: Choose where “{{name}}” should live. Everything inside it moves too.
deleteDescription: “{{name}}” and everything inside it will be deleted, along with their history.

tree.title: A folder is a document
tree.lede: Every document can hold other documents. The one holding them is still something you can write in, so a group can explain itself.
tree.heading: Writing
tree.body: Everything I keep noticing about how writing actually works, and how little of it survives being turned into a rule…
tree.childThree: Literary resources and ideas for short fiction

history.title: Every day is kept
history.lede: A document records what changed on each day you wrote in it, so you can see how a thought moved rather than only where it ended up.
history.caption: What changed on 4 March
history.before:
Walking helps me think.

I should try cold showers after waking up to improve focus.
history.after:
Walking helps me think — but only alone.

Cold or warm showers don't seem to have any effect on my day.

calendar.title: See the writing on the calendar
calendar.lede: The calendar grows a Notebook tab, shaded by how much you wrote each day across the whole notebook. A day spent cutting rather than adding shows as a quiet one.
